00054 /**
00055  * @brief               Show a HTML file in its own dialog
00056  *
00057  * This function is similar to the alert APIs, but instead of showing a text
00058  * string and icon, a HTML file is rendered into the window. The command
00059  * buttons all will dismiss the dialog. If no URI (file:// or http://) prefix
00060  * is used, the path is assumed to be the absolute file name.
00061  *
00062  * pSelectedButton in an input and output argument.  For input, it signifies
00063  * which command button has initial focus.  For output, it communicates which
00064  * command button was selected by the user.  The value of 0 represents the
00065  * leftmost command button, while a value of 1 represents the second command
00066  * button. If pSelectedButton is NULL, or if the input value of pSelectedButton 
00067  * is more than (number of command buttons - 1), then the initial focus is 
00068  * given to the leftmost command button.   The output value of pSelectedButton
00069  * is not defined if HxHtmlViewShowFile does not return HX_OK.
00070  *
00071  * Like alerts, the rightmost command button is used as the escape button
00072  * (i.e., pressing the Delete key acts on this button).
00073  *
00074  * @param pFilename     IN:     String containing full pathname to HTML file
00075  *                              or URL to show. See HxHtmlViewSetLocation for
00076  *                              an example.
00077  * @param pBounds       IN:     Position and size of the dialog to display or NULL for default size
00078  * @param pTitle        IN:     Title of HTML dialog, or NULL
00079  * @param pButtonLabel1 IN:     String for first command button
00080  * @param pButtonLabel2 IN:     String for second command button, or NULL
00081  * @param pButtonLabel3 IN:     String for third command button, or NULL
00082  * @param pSelectedButton  IN/OUT: Pointer to number of selected command button
00083  *                              or NULL if information not needed. Defaults
00084  *                              to the left most button.
00085  */
00086 HxResult HxHtmlViewShowFile(const char *pFilename, const HxRectangle_t* pBounds,
00087                             const char *pTitle,
00088                             const char* pButtonLabel1, const char* pButtonLabel2, 
00089                             const char* pButtonLabel3, uint32_t* pSelectedButton);

00091 /**

00098  * earlier in the program.

00105 /**

00107  *
00108  * This function is called to initialize the HTML Viewer library,
00109  * giving it access to the Intetnet connection to load additional
00110  * data.  This is used for programs where the library needs to have
00111  * access to the external web.  Due to limitations in the HTML
00112  * library, this online/offline flag is set on a per-library basis and
00113  * can only be set when the library is first loaded.

00115  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00116  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.

00118 HxResult HxHtmlViewInitOnline(void);

00136  *                              and sets *hHtmlView to NULL.
